reuse.why: Linking reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount; the download side follows the tree's one-function-per-provider pattern since no shared download helper exists.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near copy of downloadEnableBankingTransactions/downloadAkahuTransactions (token, post, error check, response reshaping) instead of extracting the common standard-format download.

placement.why: Handler, sync dispatch and server config are in the right places, but SyncServerFintegraAccount is put into simplefin.ts while every other provider has its own types/models file.

scope.why: Only the server-side pieces needed for the new provider are added.

maintainability.why: Linking is thin and consistent, but a fifth copy of the download boilerplate and a misplaced type add to the per-provider sprawl.
